parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction.

parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem:
Fig. 7.1 shows a coil at rest in a uniform magnetic field that is parallel to the axis of the coil.

{{figure:9702_s24_42_q07_figure_7_1}}

Fig. 7.1

The coil is connected to a centre-zero voltmeter.

The flux density $B$ of the uniform magnetic field varies with time $t$ as shown in Fig. 7.2.

{{figure:9702_s24_42_q07_figure_7_2}}

Fig. 7.2

The coil consists of 340 turns, each of cross-sectional area $3.2 \times 10^{-4} \text{m}^2$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the maximum magnetic flux through **one** turn of the coil.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Determine the maximum rate of change of magnetic flux linkage in the coil.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: State the maximum electromotive force (e.m.f.) $V_0$ induced across the coil.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
(b)(v)
parts.text:
The variation of $V$ with $t$ can be described by

$$V = A \sin Bt$$

where $A$ and $B$ are constants.

Determine the values of $A$ and $B$. Give units with your answers.
